caption: As urban density increases, transportation systems face a critical transformation. Emerging autonomous networks and electric mobility solutions are reshaping how people and goods move through modern cities. While many infrastructure upgrades remain conceptual, engineers are actively testing new approaches to reduce congestion and lower carbon emissions. These developments point toward an integrated transit ecosystem combining shared autonomous vehicles with high-speed rail. How will your daily commute change in the coming decades? Share your thoughts below. #FutureOfMobility #SmartCities #AutonomousVehicles #GreenTransit #UrbanPlanning
